Araliaceae.key_door: creeping Hydrocotyle + peltate round leaf + tiny umbel/verticillate inflorescence + compressed ribbed fruit

Garryaceae.key_door: opposite leathery leaves + dioecious petal-less aments + dark berries

Cordiaceae.key_door: rough broad leaf + large white yellow-throated sympetalous flower + pale drupe; narrow Cordiaceae family treatment explicit

Balsaminaceae.key_door: translucent succulent stem + orange spurred zygomorphic flower + fused anther cap + explosive capsule

Project recognizes Cordiaceae under a narrow modern Boraginales family treatment; Kew POWO currently stores Cordia in broad Boraginaceae sensu lato.
